- **Routes around the glacial cirques (Circos glaciares) of San Miguel, San Gaudioso and Morca.** These go through some of the park's most dramatic scenery.
- **Forest trails among the beech and oak woods.** An example is the area around the Fuente de los Frailes, which is especially beautiful in autumn.
